answers.reason: The senate decides on university-wide matters and is chaired by the president, so junior professors do not have a seat there.
The budget planning round is part of the leadership's domain, not a body for junior professors.
Appointment committees select candidates for professorships, which includes junior professorships.
Faculty matters are decided in the faculty council where faculty members take part.
The study commission prepares degree programmes and advises on teaching within the faculty.
Examination boards decide on student examination matters.
The internal research funding round awards small grants for research projects in the faculty, which concerns professors.
Module revisions relate to degree programmes handled within the faculty bodies.
Laboratory equipment procurement is handled within the faculty.
Orientation week planning is for new students and student representatives.
